findings.issue: In describe("lasso selection modes"), the drawLasso helper calls h.app.setActiveTool({ type: "lasso" }) unconditionally before every lasso gesture, which clears selectedElementIds before the Shift+lasso gesture at line 1878 and causes assertSelectedElements([frame.id, standaloneRect.id]) at line 1887 to fail.
findings.fix: Activate the lasso tool once inside renderWithBoxSelectionMode (or guard the call in drawLasso with if (h.state.activeTool.type !== "lasso")) so that consecutive and Shift-modified lasso gestures do not clear the existing selection.
